observations: Red sport motorcycle with 'Ninja' branding on the rear fairing.
The rear taillight is a single LED unit.
The rear exhaust pipe is a single chrome pipe.
The front fairing has a black carbon fiber-style panel.
The motorcycle is parked on a tiled pavement.
The rear tire shows significant dust and wear.
The front tire has red decorative stripes on the sidewall.
The handlebars feature a diamond-shaped logo on the center clamp.

claims.evidence: The model name 'Ninja' is visible, but the specific model number is not legible in any photo.
The photos show the rear tire and exhaust, but there is no odometer reading or mileage stamp visible.
The photos show the exterior, but the engine, transmission, and internal mechanical condition are not visible.
This is a subjective statement about the rider's experience and the motorcycle's condition.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may not be a Zx12R model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine number plate (usually on the side of the engine case).

risks.risk: The engine may be seized or have high internal wear.
risks.proof: A video of the motorcycle running or a photo of the engine compartment.

risks.risk: The clutch may be faulty or the transmission may be in poor condition.
risks.proof: A video of the motorcycle being ridden or a photo of the clutch area.

risks.risk: The rear tire may be a high-mileage or used tire.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear tire with the tread depth marked.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine number plate (usually on the side of the engine case).
Photo of the rear tire with the tread depth marked.
Video of the motorcycle running or a photo of the engine compartment.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
